title_sq: APARTAMENT PREMIUM PER SHITJE NE DOWN TOWN ONE!
description_sq:
Shitet apartament ne nje nga godinat me prestigjioze ne rrugen e Elbasanit.
Organizohet ne nje ambjent ndenje me kuzhine, tre dhoma fjetie, dy tualete dhe nje ballkon.
Ne apartament jane bere investime teknike me cilesi premium.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 23-te dhe ka pamje te lire nga Xhamia e Namazgjase dhe Rruga e Elbasanit.
title_en: PREMIUM APARTMENT FOR SALE IN DOWN TOWN ONE!
description_en: Apartment for sale in one of the most prestigious buildings on Elbasan Street. It is organized in a living room with kitchen, three bedrooms, two toilets and a balcony. Premium quality technical investments have been made in the apartment. The apartment is located on the 23rd floor and has a clear view of Namazgja Mosque and Elbasan Street.
